import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def _norm(s):
    if pd.isna(s):
        return pd.NA
    return str(s).strip().upper()


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    orders = inputs["orders"].copy()
    price_list = inputs["price_list"].copy()

    # ---- expression: sku_norm = UPPER(TRIM(sku)) ----
    orders["sku_norm"] = orders["sku"].apply(_norm)
    price_list["sku_norm"] = price_list["sku"].apply(_norm)

    orders["_row_id"] = range(len(orders))

    # Only rows with a non-null sku_norm can ever match (NULL sku_norm never matches)
    valid_orders = orders[orders["sku_norm"].notna()]

    if len(valid_orders) > 0 and len(price_list) > 0:
        merged = valid_orders.merge(
            price_list,
            on="sku_norm",
            suffixes=("", "_pl"),
        )

        merged = merged[merged["valid_from"] <= merged["order_date"]]

        if len(merged) > 0:
            # pick GREATEST valid_from, tie-break LOWEST list_id
            merged = merged.sort_values(
                by=["_row_id", "valid_from", "list_id"],
                ascending=[True, False, True],
            )

            best = merged.drop_duplicates(subset=["_row_id"], keep="first")
            best = best[["_row_id", "unit_price"]]
        else:
            best = pd.DataFrame(columns=["_row_id", "unit_price"])
    else:
        best = pd.DataFrame(columns=["_row_id", "unit_price"])

    orders = orders.merge(best, on="_row_id", how="left")

    orders["price_flag"] = np.where(orders["unit_price"].notna(), "OK", "NO_PRICE")
    orders["unit_price"] = orders["unit_price"].fillna(0)

    # ---- expression: ext_amount = qty * unit_price ----
    # a NULL qty gives a NULL ext_amount (multiplication with NaN -> NaN automatically)
    orders["ext_amount"] = orders["qty"] * orders["unit_price"]

    # ---- router: rules evaluated in order; NULL predicate is not true ----
    qty = orders["qty"]
    price_flag = orders["price_flag"]
    ext_amount = orders["ext_amount"]

    qty_is_null = qty.isna()
    qty_ge_100 = (qty >= 100).fillna(False)

    cond_review = (price_flag == "NO_PRICE") | qty_is_null | qty_ge_100

    ext_ge_1000 = (ext_amount >= 1000).fillna(False)
    cond_bulk = ext_ge_1000

    ext_lt_50 = (ext_amount < 50).fillna(False)
    cond_small = ext_lt_50

    conditions = [cond_review, cond_bulk, cond_small]
    choices = ["REVIEW", "BULK", "SMALL"]

    orders["route"] = np.select(conditions, choices, default="STANDARD")

    # ---- output 1: order_enriched ----
    order_enriched = orders[["order_id", "sku_norm", "unit_price", "route"]].copy()

    # ---- aggregator: group by route, order_date ----
    grouped = orders.groupby(["route", "order_date"], dropna=False)

    order_count = grouped.size().reset_index(name="order_count")
    total_ext = grouped["ext_amount"].apply(lambda s: s.sum(skipna=True)).reset_index(name="total_ext")

    route_daily = order_count.merge(total_ext, on=["route", "order_date"], how="left")
    route_daily["total_ext"] = route_daily["total_ext"].fillna(0)

    route_daily = route_daily[["route", "order_date", "order_count", "total_ext"]]

    return {
        "order_enriched": order_enriched,
        "route_daily": route_daily,
    }
